d: Short, jet black hair with choppy bangs and a slightly messy texture is adorned with small red and blue clips. The eyes are a dark brown shade with a sleepy, half-lidded expression on a face with the apparent maturity of a young child. This petite build is dressed in a white sleeveless sailor-style dress featuring a red and white striped collar, a red necktie, and green and red stripes along the hem, with the letters "SC" printed in red on the skirt. A miniature grey ship model is perched atop the head as a hair accessory.
